How to use this app (User Guide)

1. Choose milk: Increase quantities for 1L Can, 500ml Pack or 250ml Cup using the + button.

2. Milk available: Check current stock in the app. Admin updates stock; it decreases when an order is recorded.

3. Address & GPS: Enter your full name, phone number and Chagallu address. Pinning location is optional; permission is requested only when you tap the button.

4. Payment & WhatsApp order: Before paying by UPI, verify recipient name and amount in the app; showing the QR does not confirm payment. Send the message when WhatsApp opens. Dairy staff confirm the order separately.
